request.description: One lead offered to or worked by the firm, by lead id, with masked contacts and `availableActions`. Returns 404 once the firm no longer holds the lead (declined, expired, revoked or returned). Partner context. The firm owner sees every lead offered to the firm; a firm member (agent) sees only leads the owner handed to them. Lead protection: before acceptance the name is shortened (e.g. `Ramesh K.`) and the business name and notes are hidden; contact details stay masked until revealed, and every reveal is logged.

response.name: 200 OK
